lesson: [2026-09-28 retrospective interpretation; no new experiment] The completed causal decoder sweep reported own-cue lift 2.41 versus audio-only 2.41 on JD and 1.31 versus 1.33 on RPMC, but per-song decoder confidence intervals were not stored, leaving G10.2-self failed and its uncertainty requirement unqualified while G10.2-size is complete. In the separate JD operator-head test, own-cue lift 1.83 was below audio-only 2.32 (paired difference -0.49, CI [-0.94, -0.15]) and reference-history 3.17, showing that the privileged-history advantage did not carry over under this tested recursion. The operator-head interval cannot fill the decoder endpoint, absent decoder intervals do not establish equivalence, and these results do not reject all history methods or establish human LIGHT acceptance.
